profile.headline: Software Developer at CarMax
profile.summary:
Software Developer at CarMax in Richmond, VA
Graduated in December 2021 with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Public Policy at the University of North Carolina Chapel Hill

positions.title: Machine Learning Research Intern
positions.description: Build, train, and test Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) using Python and Tensorflow API to predict ocean water velocities to optimize marine glider navigation for climate change research.

positions.title: Chancellor's Science Scholar
positions.description: CSS is a merit-based scholarship for high-achieving students from all backgrounds to pursue STEM degrees and careers in scientific leadership. Scholars participate in cutting-edge research, professional development, leadership training, mentorship, and other programming designed to pave the way for academic success and future achievement.

company.name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

positions.title: Founder and Executive Director
positions.description:
- Lead an executive team to plan and host one of the first hackathons in the nation for LGBTQ+ students in tech with almost 200 registrants from across the country
- Unite with other organizations for underrepresented students in tech to host workshops, panels, peer study groups, and community events

positions.title: Co-President
positions.description:
Preside over 31 student organizations, 3 staff-led programs, and more than 4,000 members of the hub for social justice and activism at UNC Chapel Hill.
Cultivate community and collaboration between groups within the Campus Y to expand advocacy, education, and direct service work in the local community and beyond.

positions.title: Director of Membership
positions.description:
Led the First Year Council, a group of 12 first year students, and guided them through a year-long introduction to social equity work
Increased the number of annually registered members by 20% from the previous year and implemented policies to improve retention
Collaborated with current members, other student organizations, and community partners to address racial disparities within Campus Y membership

positions.title: First Year Member-at-Large
positions.description:
Devised a survey that matches first-year students with social justice organization within the Campus Y using an algorithm based on interest keywords and time availability
Engaged students with membership events to increase first-year participation in the Y

positions.title: #TechProud
positions.description: One of 28 attendees selected out of 1,000+ applicants to attend a two-day interactive program for second-year computer science majors focused on professional and technical development, including networking, personal branding, resume writing and coding challenges.

positions.title: Leadership Lunch Intern
positions.description:
Managed a $10,000 budget for seven lunch & learns featuring queer leaders as guest speakers
Developed programing focused on LGBTQ leadership, intersectionality, and activism
Analyzed evaluation data to write a comprehensive report on the Leadership Lunch program and the effectiveness of each session

positions.title: Social Epidemiology Researcher
positions.description: Researched racial disparities in the prevalence of household food insecurity with CDC public health data.

company.name: UNC Gillings School of Global Public Health

educations.schoolName: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics

honors.title: CSS Distinguished Scholar
honors.description: CSS Distinguished Scholar awards recognize exceptional third- and fourth-year scholars who truly exemplify the program’s core values of academic excellence, undergraduate research, inclusion, and community.
honors.issuer: Issued by Chancellor's Science Scholars at University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill · May 2020

honors.title: Order of the Golden Fleece
honors.description: The Order of the Golden Fleece is the oldest and highest honor society at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. I was inducted for my work advancing LGBTQ+ rights on campus as the first transgender Co-President of the Campus Y and founder of queer_hack.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill · Apr 2020

organizations.name: Creating Univeristy Born Entreprenuer (CUBE)
organizations.description: CUBE is a year-long mentorship program for exceptional young social entrepreneurs at UNC. Working with a cohort model, entrepreneurs have access to capacity building outside the classroom, coaching and mentoring from seasoned entrepreneurs, co-working space, and seed funding for venture development.
